tasks.title: Gerwin Sturm: 8×8 signed grid precreasing
tasks.instruction: Complete ONLY the 8×8 grid example on source page 1. The supplied sheet already holds the first centre fold of the first panel; open it and continue. Include the shown turnover, all remaining horizontal and vertical creases, and finish with the sheet unfolded. Do not continue the later odd-division examples or fold the Porcupine. The first sheet face corresponds to the grey face in the diagram. This task is to complete the depicted precrease pattern and finish unfolded on the shown face. It does not require the reference execution order or which half is moved for an otherwise equivalent crease. All specified material mountain/valley directions must have been physically formed on the retained paper history; do not add opposite-direction precreases or obvious non-target crease lines. Undo does not count as retaining a crease.

tasks.instruction: The supplied paper is prepared through printed step 6 of Pureland Penguin. tasks.title: NASA Dart: second pair of edge-to-centre folds (prefix)
tasks.instruction: The rectangle has already completed all three instruction rows on page 1 (PDF page19): lengthwise fold, unfold, and both upper corners folded to the centre. On page 2 (PDF page20), complete ONLY the FIRST instruction row, bringing both new sloping upper edges to the centre. Stop at the result of that row, before the next row tells you to fold the whole packet in half, and call finish. This is a scoped intermediate-state task, not the complete airplane. The paper keeps the source 8.5:11 aspect but is scaled to 15 cm width. Blue is the original front and cream the original back.

accounting_reconciliation.scope: Matched provider rows span historical and current studies. Partial verified spending is not the total payment for this cohort; original round cost snapshots remain unchanged.

low_score_check.conclusion: Descriptive numeric check only; per-failure source/interface attribution is still required. Repeats of two tasks are not independent samples of all origami.

historical.note: Different tasks, release and policy. Historical O01–O03 are shown separately; score differences cannot identify a causal change in model capability.

preregistration.confirmation_rule: If batch1 suggests low success, rerun all six task-model combinations with fresh UUIDs as a separately preregistered confirmation batch. Never overwrite or silently retry the first batch.
preregistration.validity_rule: Environment errors, identity discrepancies, ambiguous diagrams, and unsupported equivalent valid actions cannot be evidence of model incapability. Report operational scores including environment errors separately and require at least four valid episodes per model for confirmation.
preregistration.causal_audit: Inspect every failure against diagrams, public instructions and documented interfaces. Replay claimed valid-but-rejected actions as targeted environment diagnostics; keep rejected/rollback evidence. Do not change an answer, prompt, threshold or action interface based on task/model failure and still pool scores.
preregistration.adaptation_rule: If these tasks score high or failures are confounded, qualify new multi-layer or spatial tasks with independent references and negative controls before freezing next batch. Preserve every candidate and every outcome. This is an adaptive development challenge set, not an unbiased held-out model ranking.
preregistration.statistics_note: Small repeated sample, descriptive low-score evidence only; report counts and intervals, not guaranteed model ceiling.
prepaid_fixes: Full-paper viewport for supported rectangles and translations, preserving world coordinate ticks.
Generic task scope precedence and public 600-frame motion-bound disclosure; same new policy for every evaluated model/task.
Explicit repeat IDs and correct precrease suite metadata.

boundaries: Completion marker, report hash, frozen plan, identity and required evidence gates precede scored success/failure.
